name: Medusa acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, 6 tasks. Average acceptance length τ = 2.44 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 2.07x mean across tasks.
notes: Medusa-1 (frozen backbone). Uses tree-based attention for parallel verification. Typical acceptance scheme is lossy (does not guarantee distribution preservation). Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding.
